<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#F5F2E9;}
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  :root{
    --bg:#F5F2E9;
    --surface:#F7F4EB;
    --ink:#1B2620;
    --muted:#5C665D;
    --olive:#4F5E43;
    --gold:#B4914A;
    --blue:#8C9FB2;
    --line:#A3AC9E;
  }
  .slide{
    position:relative;
    width:1920px;
    height:1080px;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#F5F2E9;
    color:#1B2620;
    font-family:'Archivo','Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  .serif{font-family:Georgia,'Songti SC','SimSun','Times New Roman',serif;}

  /* ---------- background field ---------- */
  .bg-field{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1100px 780px at 2% 0%,rgba(180,145,74,.09),transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(880px 760px at 47% 46%,rgba(140,159,178,.10),transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(950px 760px at 95% 95%,rgba(79,94,67,.10),transparent 72%),
      linear-gradient(168deg,#F8F5EC 0%,#F5F2E9 52%,#EFECE1 100%);
  }
  .bg-field:after{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(27,38,32,.045) 0 1px,transparent 1px 160px);
    opacity:.85;
  }
  .gridline{position:absolute;z-index:1;background:rgba(27,38,32,.055);width:1px;height:1080px;top:0;}
  .gl1{left:480px}.gl2{left:960px}.gl3{left:1440px}
  .dot-field{
    position:absolute;z-index:1;opacity:.16;
    background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(27,38,32,.45) 1.05px,transparent 1.15px);
    background-size:15px 15px;
  }
  .dot-1{left:96px;top:1002px;width:820px;height:70px;}
  .edge-prism{
    position:absolute;z-index:1;left:1846px;top:0;width:74px;height:1080px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(140,159,178,.16),rgba(140,159,178,.06) 60%,rgba(140,159,178,0));
  }
  .edge-prism:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:32px;top:0;width:20px;height:1080px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);}

  /* ---------- frame rails ---------- */
  .top-rule{position:absolute;left:96px;top:48px;width:1728px;height:1px;z-index:6;background:rgba(27,38,32,.34);}
  .left-rail{position:absolute;left:56px;top:48px;width:1px;height:960px;z-index:6;background:rgba(27,38,32,.18);}
  .rail-tick{position:absolute;left:50px;width:13px;height:1px;z-index:7;background:rgba(27,38,32,.34);}
  .rail-tick.t1{top:340px}.rail-tick.t2{top:640px}.rail-tick.t3{top:940px}
  .rail-label{
    position:absolute;left:40px;top:610px;z-index:15;
    transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:left top;
    font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4.6px;color:#7b857c;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .top-meta{
    position:absolute;left:98px;top:61px;z-index:15;
    font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4.2px;color:#4f5b53;
  }
  .register{
    position:absolute;right:-7px;top:-60px;width:260px;height:260px;z-index:4;
    border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.30);
  }
  .register .r2{position:absolute;inset:12px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.16);}
  .register .r3{
    position:absolute;inset:28px;border-radius:50%;
    background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,rgba(79,94,67,.18),rgba(79,94,67,0) 24%,rgba(140,159,178,.28) 50%,rgba(140,159,178,.06) 78%,rgba(79,94,67,.18));
  }
  .register .r4{position:absolute;inset:40px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(245,242,233,.90);border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.08);}
  .register .dot{
    position:absolute;left:46px;top:154px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(180,145,74,.13);
  }

  /* ---------- headline ---------- */
  .eyebrow{
    position:absolute;left:96px;top:150px;z-index:10;
    font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4.6px;color:var(--olive);
  }
  .title{
    position:absolute;left:94px;top:184px;z-index:10;margin:0;
    width:1420px;font-size:68px;line-height:1.12;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1px;
    color:#16211b;font-family:Georgia,'Songti SC','SimSun','Times New Roman',serif;
  }
  .subtitle{
    position:absolute;left:96px;top:290px;z-index:10;margin:0;
    width:1300px;font-size:21px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.4px;
  }

  /* ---------- section head ---------- */
  .section-head{position:absolute;left:96px;top:372px;width:1728px;z-index:10;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
  .sec-label{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4.6px;color:var(--olive);}
  .legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;}
  .lg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:#6b756c;}
  .d{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;}
  .d-gold{background:var(--gold);}
  .d-blue{background:var(--blue);}
  .d-grey{border:1px dashed #A3AC9E;background:transparent;}

  /* ---------- timeline ---------- */
  .timeline{position:absolute;left:96px;top:412px;width:1728px;height:300px;z-index:10;}
  .phases{display:flex;gap:26px;height:196px;}
  .card{
    position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:22px 30px 20px;
    background:linear-gradient(158deg,rgba(255,255,255,.66),rgba(247,244,235,.40));
    border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.17);
    border-top:2px solid rgba(79,94,67,.55);
  }
  .card.c1{flex:1;}
  .card.c2{flex:3;background:linear-gradient(158deg,rgba(255,255,255,.80),rgba(245,240,228,.56));border-top-color:rgba(79,94,67,.80);}
  .card.c3{flex:1;}
  .card-top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;}
  .wk{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;color:#6b756c;}
  .card-id{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;color:rgba(27,38,32,.32);}
  .phase{
    font-size:38px;line-height:1.2;color:#16211b;letter-spacing:1px;
    font-family:Georgia,'Songti SC','SimSun','Times New Roman',serif;
  }
  .card-note{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#7b857c;margin-top:6px;}
  .card-bot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
  .chip{
    display:inline-block;padding:5px 15px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2.4px;
    color:#8a6a2e;background:rgba(180,145,74,.13);border:1px solid rgba(180,145,74,.52);
  }
  .axis{position:absolute;left:0;top:236px;width:1728px;height:1px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.30);}
  .mark{position:absolute;top:236px;width:1px;height:9px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.30);}
